Ecommpay Launches QR Code Payments for Customer-Defined and Preset Amounts
summary:
Enabling merchants to collect variable one-off payments such as tips and donations, inclusive global payments platform, Ecommpay, has launched QR Code Payment. The new solution provides a single static QR code which merchants can display anywhere, whether on a printed sign, a receipt, or a web page. Payment amounts can be preselected or set by the consumer, and payment can be made using any available method, for significant flexibility.
Critically, the QR code is created, customised and published directly from the Ecommpay dashboard without development or integration work or coding required. And delivered on a fully merchant-branded Hosted Payment Page, the payment journey provides the customer with a consistent and trustworthy experience whether they are leaving a tip in a restaurant, donating to charity or paying a micro-merchant.
“We have built QR Code Payments to make it quick and simple to send one-off payments – the digital equivalent to leaving a £5 note tucked under a glass when you leave the table or throwing a few coins into a collection bucket as it passes,” commented Artus Zaremba, Head of Payment Solutions, Ecommpay. “Fewer customers carry cash today, so servers and charities can miss out even if someone wants to leave a tip or make a donation. With QR Code Payments, merchants and charities can display a static QR code to help capture these payments.
“This latest enhancement also provides a simple solution for small or micro-businesses to accept payments without using a card machine – for example, pay-as-you-go bootcamp sessions in the local park, or selling goods at a farmers’ market or school fair. The merchant can choose whether they or the customer sets the amount and choose which payment methods are made available. They also set the look and feel of the payment page, ensuring they are in full control, and customers get the best experience, and the same QR code can be used indefinitely, until deactivated by the merchant.”
Key features
Compatible with all payment methods available with Ecommpay.
Supports 3DS authentication and AVS check.
Static QR code / payment link - A single reusable QR code that opens an own-branded Ecommpay payment page, QR code can be used on printed materials, physical signage or online.
Pre-checkout Page - A customised customer-facing page for entering or selecting the payment amount before being redirected to make payment - merchant configures the amount-selection mode per link, in one of three options: custom amount only, preselected amounts only, or preselected amounts plus a custom-amount option. The merchant also controls branding including logo, background image, title, description, action-button text and thank-you page.
Dashboard lifecycle management – Full self-service control of the QR code: creation, customisation, copy/download, and deactivation, limited to merchant admin and operations roles.Please
NoYesPayments03 Sep, 2026
content: Global payments platform Ecommpay has launched a new QR Code Payments solution designed to let merchants collect variable one-off payments like tips and donations. The static QR codes can be used on printed signs, receipts, or web pages, allowing customers to pay custom or preset amounts. Managed directly from the Ecommpay dashboard, the feature requires no coding and provides a fully branded payment journey with flexible options.

Nexi Partners With JCB and UnionPay International to Simplify Public Transport in Campania
summary:
Nexi, the European PayTech leader, announces two strategic partnerships with JCB and UnionPay International (UPI) to expand both global payment schemes across public transport in the Campania region of southern Italy, including Naples. The partnerships are delivered through the Unico Campania consortium, which manages integrated ticketing for multiple public transport operators in the region.
Thanks to these agreements, millions of tourists holding JCB and UnionPay cards, particularly from Asia, will be able to use the Tap & Go service, allowing them to access public transport and purchase tickets simply by tapping their contactless payment card or smartphone at enabled gates and ticket validators. The service will be available across a wide range of metro lines, funiculars and buses across the region.
In addition, JCB and UnionPay cards will be accepted throughout Unico Campania’s entire ecosystem, including physical ticket offices.
For passengers, the service delivers several key benefits, including: no need to purchase tickets in advance, greater convenience and enhanced security, automatic best fare calculation based on journeys taken within 24 hours, and smoother access to public transport.
The agreements between Nexi and JCB and UnionPay International represent a significant step forward in the digitalization of urban mobility in the Campania region, once again highlighting how digital payments are a key enabler in the transformation of public services for citizens.
“The new service launched in the Campania region together with JCB and UnionPay International demonstrates our ability to bring the best payment solutions to local communities across Italy, leveraging both our technology and our strong partnerships with global players - said Filippo Maria Signoretti, Merchant Solutions Director at Nexi - These agreements also allow us to support the digitalization of services for citizens, with mobility representing a key element in this transformation”.
Hiroyuki Katano, Executive Vice President, JCB International Co., Ltd., said: “We are pleased to partner with Nexi and Unico Campania to expand JCB acceptance across public transport in the Campania region in southern Italy, including Naples and surrounding areas such as Pompeii. This will make it easier for JCB Cardmembers, particularly from Asia to access transport services seamlessly using contactless payments, without the need to purchase tickets in advance. By enabling simple and familiar payment experiences, we aim to enhance convenience for travellers while helping local operators capture growing international demand”.
James Yang, Executive Vice President of European Region, UnionPay international, said: “We are pleased to support the expansion of digital mobility services in the Campania region through this collaboration. Enabling seamless, secure and convenient payment experiences in public transportation is becoming increasingly important for international travelers and local communities alike. This milestone represents another meaningful step toward making urban mobility more accessible and user-friendly through innovative payment technology.”
In May 2024, Nexi, JCB, and UnionPay International introduced this payment model for the first time in Europe within public transport in Rome, marking a significant milestone in the innovation of urban mobility services.
The service will be progressively made available across several lines and services of the Unico Campania Consortium. The updated list of enabled services is available on the official Unico Campania website.
NoYesPayments03 Sep, 2026
content: Nexi has partnered with JCB and UnionPay International to expand digital payment options across public transport in Italy's Campania region. Delivered through the Unico Campania consortium, the initiative allows international travelers to use the Tap & Go service with their contactless cards and smartphones. This collaboration aims to modernize urban mobility and simplify ticketing for millions of visitors, following a similar launch in Rome.

title: Hopscotch Taps Unlimit to Keep Payments Moving Through India’s Seasonal Shopping Spikes
summary:
India’s largest online children’s fashion brand, Hopscotch, has deployed a payment solution from Unlimit, a global financial infrastructure company, across its website and mobile app. The integration is designed to support checkout performance during seasonal launches, festive campaigns and flash sales, when traffic and transaction volumes can rise sharply. It processes domestic Unified Payments Interface (UPI) and card transactions.
Hopscotch has built a community of more than six million mothers across India and operates a fast-moving catalogue of more than 40,000 products, with around 500 new styles added every day. Peak periods can place additional pressure on checkout: according to Unicommerce, Indian ecommerce order volumes rose 24% year on year during the 2025 Diwali season. To help Hopscotch convert shopper intent into revenue when transaction volumes are at their highest, Unlimit routes transactions through available payment paths and retries eligible payments.
Irene Skrynova, CEO, Global Payments at Unlimit, said: “The battle for conversion is not won when a shopper clicks ‘buy’. It is won when the payment goes through. During peak retail periods, every avoidable failure is a customer and a sale that a retailer has already worked hard to earn.”
NoYesPayments03 Sep, 2026
content: Indian children’s fashion brand Hopscotch has partnered with global financial infrastructure company Unlimit to integrate a new payment solution across its website and mobile app. Designed to handle seasonal shopping spikes, festive campaigns, and flash sales, the technology supports domestic Unified Payments Interface and card transactions while optimizing checkout performance and payment routing during high-traffic retail periods.
